title: CRUD the Hard Way
prompt: Implement setup(conn) that creates table items(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, qty INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0), and restock(conn, name, qty) inserting a row and returning its id.

tests.name: creates and inserts
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
setup(conn)
iid = restock(conn, 'tea', 10)
row = conn.execute('SELECT name, qty FROM items WHERE id = ?', (iid,)).fetchone()
assert row == ('tea', 10)
tests.hint: CREATE TABLE then INSERT with placeholder values; commit.

tests.name: constraint enforced
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
setup(conn)
try:
    conn.execute('INSERT INTO items (name, qty) VALUES (?, ?)', (None, 1))
    failed = False
except sqlite3.IntegrityError:
    failed = True
assert failed
tests.hint: NOT NULL must be in the schema — the database rejects violations.
